findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_balance, get_portfolio, get_token_info, get_token_price, get_dex_price_candles, get_swap_quote, get_allowance, get_nft, get_gas, get_block, get_block_at_time, get_transaction, decode_tx_logs, decode_calldata, detect_proxy, get_ens_records, check_contract_before_interaction, check_sanctions, get_account_nonce, get_transaction_receipt, get_event_logs, eth_call, estimate_gas, get_storage_at, get_erc1155_balance, get_chain_info, get_erc20_transfers, get_block_number, get_contract_code, get_total_supply, get_nft_owner, get_funding_rates, get_perp_markets, get_solana_balance, get_solana_token_balances, get_solana_transaction, get_solana_signatures, get_solana_account, get_solana_token_info · Private data: get_balance, get_portfolio, get_token_info, get_token_price, get_allowance, get_nft, detect_proxy, resolve_ens, get_ens_records, check_contract_before_interaction, get_event_logs, get_erc1155_balance, get_erc20_transfers, get_contract_code, get_total_supply, get_nft_owner, get_solana_balance, get_solana_token_balances, get_solana_token_info · Public sink: resolve_ens, get_ens_records, check_contract_before_interaction, get_account_nonce, estimate_gas · Destructive: decode_calldata.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
